about: bank 0 $6800-$6FFF: game phase routines from the starting wave select screen and the continue offer through begin act, wave 1, wave 2 and the start of wave 3 (phases $0D-$12, $15-$26, $45-$47)

B0:681A.name: sel_wave_init
B0:681A.desc: phase $0D, init of the starting difficulty select screen. Star Wars' PHISDS (select a death star) changed: loads picture set 0 into the pseudo vector ROM, clears the phase timer and the message offsets, sets the message colour and turns on message $2B (select starting difficulty, the three waves with their bonuses and the two instructions targets), then steps to the execute phase

B0:6856.name: sel_wave_exec
B0:6856.desc: phase $0E, the starting difficulty select screen. Star Wars' PHESDS changed: the table TDTH now has five targets, three planets (easy, medium, hard = GM_DIF 0, 1, 2) and two instructions targets that pick easy and set instr_flag. Each frame it hit tests the cursor against the targets with the octagon check, draws the planets, the two instructions pictures, the cursor (yellow when on a target), the messages and a countdown, and goes to phase $0F when a fire or thumb switch is pressed on a target or, on easy, when 256 frames have passed

B0:6980.name: launch_init
B0:6980.desc: phase $0F, init of the sequence shown between the select screen and the game: picture set 0, stars (ISTAR), phase timer 0, all messages off and two sounds (AUDRC and LC63E), then falls into the execute phase

B0:6999.name: launch_exec
B0:6999.desc: phase $10: draws the sequence through LA91A (message $2C, darth vader's executor is searching for the rebel hideout, fading after frame 60 while a picture crosses the screen over the stars) for 100 frames, then goes to phase $13 (PHISG2) to start the game

B0:69B0.name: cont_offer_init
B0:69B0.desc: phase $11, init of the screen that offers a start at a higher wave after a game (PHEEGM and PHEENT come here when cont_wave is 3 or more). Runs the new game reset L678F, loads picture set 0, starts the countdown at $100, clears cont_used and the no-credit flag and turns on message $2D (you may start your next game on wave / bonus) plus one of $30 (the starting bonus of the last game was never paid), $2E (Jedi bonus earned) or $2F (Jedi bonus not earned)

B0:69F9.name: cont_offer_exec
B0:69F9.desc: phase $12, the continue offer screen, a second changed copy of Star Wars' PHESDS with one planet at cont_planet. Draws the score, the coin messages, the planet, the cursor, the messages, a countdown, the offered wave number (cont_wave + 1) and its bonus (cont_bonus, 6 or 8 digits). A fire or thumb switch pressed with the cursor on the planet takes a credit, sets GM_DIF to cont_wave and goes straight to phase $13 (PHISG2) - with no credit it puts 256 frames back on the countdown, once. When the timer reaches $200 the offer and the pending offer are cleared and the phase goes back to the banner

B0:6B55.name: begin_act_init
B0:6B55.desc: phase $15 (PHS_BGN), begin a set of four waves. Star Wars' PHIBGN changed: resets the ship's flight state (OLD1SHP), makes the BCD wave number for the display from GM_DIF + 1 (at most 99), copies GM_DIF to the level of each of the four wave types, clears Q_FRC (the wave type here), Q_RTHV and instr_run, then falls into the execute phase

B0:6B8A.name: begin_act_exec
B0:6B8A.desc: phase $16, Star Wars' PHEBGN reduced to its first two instructions: goes to phase $17, the init of wave 1

B0:6B8F.name: wave1_init
B0:6B8F.desc: phase $17, init of wave 1: picture set 1, wave type 0 in Q_FRC, jedi_left from the wave 1 quota, the Jedi letter display turned off unless a letter is being awarded, prog_count cleared. If instructions were asked for it goes to phase $43 (which comes back at wave1_setup), otherwise it falls into wave1_setup

B0:6BB8.name: wave1_setup
B0:6BB8.desc: phase $45, the rest of the wave 1 init, entered by falling in from wave1_init or from the instructions phase (table L757B): general parameters and a new ship (L630A) turned to face backwards, ground stars (ISTARG), the wave 1 objects and the progress indicator set up on the slapstic pages, player speed, position and height, timer and the hit speech flags cleared, a sound and one of two R2 speeches by the low bit of GM_DIF, single laser pair, then phase $18

B0:6C0B.name: wave1_leadin
B0:6C0B.desc: phase $18, the first 40 frames of wave 1 before anything attacks: views the scene (IPARM), ends the game through PHIS0D when the shields are gone, runs the shield gauge and the Jedi flags, turns and moves the player, then goes to phase $19

B0:6C3C.name: wave1_level_init
B0:6C3C.desc: phase $19: works out the level wave 1 is played at, 2 * w1_level + diff_add, folded into $10-$1F once it passes $1F, stores it in fire_level and its two wave 1 copies, clears the phase timer and roll_step and falls into the wave 1 play phase (PHESP1, phase $1A)

B0:6CC1.name: wave1_level_up
B0:6CC1.desc: called each frame by the wave 1 play phase once the Jedi quota is met or 100 frames have passed: steps fire_level up by one every 32 frames and w1_pace every 16 frames, both folded into $10-$1F past $1F

B0:6CF3.name: wave1_end_init
B0:6CF3.desc: phase $1B, wave 1 is over (prog_count reached 4): timer 0, a speech picked by GM_DIF (0, 1, 2, from 3 up one of the four in w1_end_spk at random), and w1_spawn = $FF so that page 2 frees the wave 1 objects. Falls into phase $1C (PHESP2), which plays on until none is left

B0:6D6A.name: wave1_exit_init
B0:6D6A.desc: phase $1D: clears the phase timer and steps to the wave 1 exit phase

B0:6D73.name: wave1_exit_exec
B0:6D73.desc: phase $1E, the flight out of wave 1: views with VEWHPA, still moves shots, explosions, glow and the shield gauge, turns the player with L778C and moves him. After 40 frames it waits for the ship to face backwards (unit vector A x at or below $C100) and at 80 frames at the latest goes to phase $1F, the init of wave 2

B0:6DBF.name: wave2_init
B0:6DBF.desc: phase $1F, init of wave 2: picture set 1, wave type 1 in Q_FRC, jedi_left from the wave 2 quota, the Jedi letter display turned off unless a letter is being awarded. With instructions asked for it goes to phase $43 (which comes back at wave2_setup), otherwise it joins wave2_setup at L6DF3, past the new ship and stars, so the flight carries on from wave 1

B0:6DE5.name: wave2_setup
B0:6DE5.desc: phase $46, the rest of the wave 2 init, entered from the instructions phase (table L757B) with a new ship facing backwards and ground stars, and at L6DF3 from wave2_init: sets up the two kinds of wave 2 objects and the progress indicator on the slapstic pages, works out fire_level from w2_level and diff_add, clears the timer, the passing bonus and the speech flags, starts a sound and a speech and goes to phase $20

B0:6E44.name: wave2_exec
B0:6E44.desc: phase $20, wave 2 play: views with LA448, ends the game through PHIG0D when the shields are gone, moves shots, explosions and the two kinds of wave 2 objects, runs the Jedi time, turns and moves the player. After 1200 frames, or once the quota is met with Jedi time running, it clears adv_hold so nothing holds the advance up. At frame 60 it shows the Jedi letters, and when walk_adv reaches 400 it goes to phase $21

B0:6EB0.name: wave2_end_init
B0:6EB0.desc: phase $21 (PHS_SP2), wave 2 is over: timer 0 and both spawn counts = $FF so that the slapstic pages free the wave 2 objects, then (at the label the matcher named PHISP2) bumps the hit speech flag and steps to phase $22

B0:6EC3.name: wave2_end_exec
B0:6EC3.desc: phase $22: plays wave 2 on, as wave2_exec does without the timing tests, until neither kind of wave 2 object has a live record, then goes to phase $23

B0:6F08.name: wave2_exit_init
B0:6F08.desc: phase $23: clears the phase timer, starts PMSF2 and the sound LC634 and falls into the wave 2 exit phase

B0:6F16.name: wave2_exit_exec
B0:6F16.desc: phase $24, the flight out of wave 2: views with LA48A, still moves shots, explosions, glow and the shield gauge, turns the player with L7796 and moves him with L7AFB for 40 frames, then goes to phase $25, the init of wave 3

B0:6F56.name: wave3_init
B0:6F56.desc: phase $25, init of wave 3: picture set 2, wave type 2 in Q_FRC, jedi_left from the wave 3 quota, the Jedi letter display turned off unless a letter is being awarded. With instructions asked for it goes to phase $43 (which comes back at wave3_setup), otherwise it falls into wave3_setup

B0:6F7A.name: wave3_setup
B0:6F7A.desc: phase $47, the rest of the wave 3 init, entered by falling in from wave3_init or from the instructions phase (table L757B): general parameters and a new ship facing backwards, stars (ISTAR), the wave 3 setup on page 3, fire_level from SP_WAV and diff_add, timer and hit speech flags cleared, the double laser pair, the theme PMTH5 and a sound, then phase $26

B0:6FC4.name: wave3_exec
B0:6FC4.desc: phase $26, wave 3 play, built on Star Wars' PHESP1: views with LA515, ends the game through PHIB0D when the shields are gone, moves shots, glows, explosions and the computer ships, runs the Jedi time, turns and moves the player and moves the stars. At frame 60 it shows the Jedi letters, after 440 frames it goes to phase $27, and while fewer than three ships are alive it adds another (ADASHP on page 3)

481B.name: gtime_1
481B.desc: second byte of GTIME, the current game's time. Cleared with it when a game starts.

4894.name: roll_step
4894.desc: word: the roll to add this frame, worked out by S1TWGD as the limited difference between the wanted roll and GD_ACT. Cleared at the start of wave 1.

4BEE.name: cont_wave
4BEE.desc: the wave (as GM_DIF, from 0) the next game may start on. Copied from pend_wave at the end of a game in which the Jedi bonus was earned - 3 or more sends the end of game to the continue offer screen. Cleared when the offer runs out.

4BEF.name: cont_bonus
4BEF.desc: 4 BCD bytes: the bonus that goes with cont_wave, the score the earlier game had when it reached that wave. Shown on the continue screen and added to the score by LB5D4.

4BF0.name: cont_bonus_1
4BF0.desc: second byte of cont_bonus (the six low digits start here).

4BF3.name: pend_wave
4BF3.desc: pending continue offer: GM_DIF + 1 noted by L7274 each time a set of four waves is finished. It becomes cont_wave at the end of the game if the Jedi bonus was earned.

4BF4.name: pend_bonus
4BF4.desc: 4 BCD bytes: the score when pend_wave was noted. It becomes cont_bonus.

4BF6.name: pend_bonus_2
4BF6.desc: third and fourth bytes of pend_bonus.

4BF8.name: cont_used
4BF8.desc: set when a game is started from the continue offer screen. Bank 1's accounting (K7421) counts such a game and clears it.

4BFB.name: bcd_lo
4BFB.desc: third byte of BCD: the two low digits BINBCD leaves.

4C4A.name: wave_bcd
4C4A.desc: wave number for the display, BCD: GM_DIF + 1, at most 99. The accounting keeps the highest one reached.

4C4C.name: w1_level
4C4C.desc: level of wave 1, set to GM_DIF at the start of each set of four waves. Its double plus diff_add is wave 1's fire_level, and page 2 picks wave 1 behaviour by it.

4C4D.name: w2_level
4C4D.desc: level of wave 2, set to GM_DIF at the start of each set of four waves.

4C4E.name: w4_level
4C4E.desc: level of wave 4, set to GM_DIF at the start of each set of four waves. (Wave 3's is SP_WAV.)

4C50.name: jedi_time
4C50.desc: word, with a fraction byte after it at $4C52: time left of the Jedi bonus. Page 1 sets it to $01C0 when the fourth letter is earned and counts it down every frame. 0 when the bonus is not running. Drawn as a bar.

4C53.name: jedi_left
4C53.desc: targets still to shoot in this wave for its Jedi letter. Loaded from the wave's quota by its init, shown on screen, counted down by the routines that score a kill. The letter is awarded when it reaches 0.

4C55.name: jedi_need_1
4C55.desc: Jedi quota of wave 1: set from the starting wave by L75AC (6, 8, 10, then GM_DIF + 9), one more each time the letter is earned and after each set of four waves, at most $5A.

4C56.name: jedi_need_2
4C56.desc: Jedi quota of wave 2, kept as jedi_need_1.

4C57.name: jedi_need_3
4C57.desc: Jedi quota of wave 3, kept as jedi_need_1. (Wave 4's is GM_BMP.)

4C5A.name: diff_add
4C5A.desc: difficulty adder: the difficulty option (OPTS1 bits 2 and 3) at the start of a game, raised by L72C4 after each finished set of waves while GM_DIF is 2 or less. Added into every wave's fire_level.

4C5B.name: fire_level
4C5B.desc: level the current wave is played at: 2 * the wave type's level + diff_add, folded into $10-$1F once past $1F. Page 1 indexes the enemy shot table with it and fires when a 5 bit random number is below it. Wave 1 steps it up every 32 frames.

4C5D.name: w1_pace
4C5D.desc: wave 1: starts as fire_level and steps up every 16 frames (wave1_level_up). Page 2 (P2_91A8) indexes its table of random delays with it, capped at 8, shorter as it rises.

4C5F.name: w2_level_b
4C5F.desc: copy of fire_level made by the wave 2 setup. Page 0 (P0_8B3A) tests it against 9.

4C60.name: gun_layout
4C60.desc: which laser gun layout is drawn and fired: 0 in waves 1 and 2 (one pair of beams), 1 in waves 3 and 4 (a second pair is added). Indexes the gun position tables.

4C61.name: instr_flag
4C61.desc: 1 when the player picked an instructions target on the select screen: each wave's init then goes to phase $43 to show that wave's instructions first. Cleared when a set of waves is finished and when a game starts from the continue offer.

4C62.name: strt_bonus
4C62.desc: 1 from the start of a game until its starting bonus has been paid, in the phase that ends the first set of four waves (L7243, LB5D4). Still set at the end of a game it selects message $30 on the continue screen.

4C63.name: w1_spawn
4C63.desc: wave 1: how many object records page 2 (P2_877C) keeps filled, 5 from its setup. 0 = add none. Minus (the end of wave phase stores $FF) = free every record not flagged $10.

4C64.name: w2_spawn_a
4C64.desc: wave 2: spawn count of the objects page 1 handles (P1_86E1), used as w1_spawn. $FF from wave2_end_init frees them.

4C65.name: w2_spawn_b
4C65.desc: wave 2: spawn count of the objects page 0 handles (P0_8705, 3 from its setup), used as w1_spawn. $FF from wave2_end_init frees them.

4C69.name: w1_active
4C69.desc: wave 1: number of live object records, counted afresh by page 2 every frame. The wave's last phase ends when it is 0.

4C6A.name: w2_active_a
4C6A.desc: wave 2: number of live records of the objects page 1 handles, counted afresh every frame.

4C6B.name: w2_active_b
4C6B.desc: wave 2: number of live records of the objects page 0 handles, counted afresh every frame.

4C72.name: rank_index
4C72.desc: index of the high score entry (7 bytes each in INITLS) the player's score has still to beat: $18, the last, at the start of a game, stepped down by bank 1 (KE209) each time the score passes that entry, minus once it beats them all. The score display shows the rank and the score to beat from it.

4C82.name: jedi_show
4C82.desc: state of the Jedi letter display: 0 off, 1 a letter is being awarded (it grows into place), 2 the letters are shown. The wave inits clear it unless it is 1, the play phases set 2 a little into the wave, attract mode flips it between 0 and 2.

4C85.name: jedi_done
4C85.desc: 1 once all four Jedi letters have been earned in this game (page 1, P1_95E2), 0 from PHISG2. At the end of the game it turns the pending continue offer into the offer and picks the message of the continue screen.

4CA1.name: prog_count
4CA1.desc: count shown by the indicator at the top of the screen in waves 1 and 2. Wave 1 counts it up from 0 and ends at 4. Wave 2 starts it at 4 and counts it down as walk_adv passes -150, -50, 50 and 150.

4CA3.name: walk_adv
4CA3.desc: word, wave 2: position of the advance on the indicator, from -400 ($FE70) up by 5 or 6 a frame to 400, which ends the wave.

4CA6.name: adv_hold
4CA6.desc: wave 2: frames the advance is held up. Hits on wave 2 objects add to it while the Jedi quota is open, the advance moves only when it is 0.

4CAC.name: ph_tim_lo
4CAC.desc: low byte of PH_TIM, the phase timer.

4CB9.name: instr_run
4CB9.desc: nonzero while the instructions phases ($43, $44) run: PHINXT bumps it, L7542 and begin_act_init clear it. The slapstic pages then leave out sounds and speech and place their objects by fixed values.

4CBF.name: pass_bonus
4CBF.desc: 3 BCD bytes, wave 2: the bonus LB61A adds to the score when the player passes close by one of the objects page 0 handles (P0_87DD). LB61A first raises it by the amount at LB71E, up to 900,000. Cleared by the wave 2 setup.

4CD4.name: cont_nocrd
4CD4.desc: continue screen: set the first time the planet is fired on with no credit, when 256 frames are put back on the countdown, so that it happens once.

4CD5.name: w2_spk_cnt
4CD5.desc: wave 2: counts the frames a page 0 test (P0_8F45) holds running. At 20 the speech SPKALW is started and the count parks at $80. Cleared by the wave 2 setup.

4CD7.name: hit_spk_done
4CD7.desc: wave 2: nonzero once the speech SPKHIT has been started by page 0 (P0_9641), or is no longer wanted - the end of wave init bumps it.

4CD8.name: glow_said
4CD8.desc: set once the speech for a shot that hits the ship while its shield is already glowing has been started (page 1, P1_94D2), so it is said once a wave. Cleared by the wave setups.

4CD9.name: hit_said
4CD9.desc: set at the first enemy shot to hit the ship in a wave (page 1, P1_94AB), when waves 3 and 4 start their music. Cleared by the wave setups.

4CDF.name: pass_bon_tmr
4CDF.desc: frames the passing bonus stays on screen: 20 from LB61A, counted down by page 1 (P1_9D45) while it shows pass_bonus.

5080.name: ship_ax
5080.desc: MS_AX+M_S1: X component (word) of unit vector A of the player's ship. $C0 in its high byte with the same in MS_BY+M_S1 turns the ship to face backwards.

questions: B0:6EBE: the header PHISP2 - SPACE WAVE 2 is a matcher artifact. The two instructions (INC $4CD7 / INC PHASE) are the tail of the wave 2 end init at L6EB0 (phase $21), nothing enters at L6EBE (table entry $21 is L6EB0), and the carried comment about Darth does not apply.

B0:6C5F PHESP1 and B0:6D2B PHESP2 carry Star Wars names and table comments (space wave 1 / 2). In ESB they are phase $1A, wave 1 play, and phase $1C, wave 1 played on until its objects are gone. I left their headers alone.

B0:6BC0, 6DED, 6F82 (and LB133): the operand shown as GM_WAV ($508A) is MS_BY+M_S1, unit vector B y of the player's ship, as in PHISG2's FACE BACKWARDS - the alias GM_WAV does not fit ESB's use of that address.

GM_DIF ($4C49) is no longer the option switch difficulty adder: in ESB it is the number of the wave set (wave number - 1), picked on the select screen and bumped by L72C4. The option difficulty lives in $4C5A (diff_add). Q_FRC ($4C4F) holds the wave type 0-3 (set by the four wave inits, used to index tables).

carried comments in this range that describe Star Wars lines and do not fit: L6810 (NO MORE BONUS COINS - it stores the difficulty adder), L6825 and the sound names at L6991 (AUDRC), L6BF0 (AUDPS), L6E3A (AUDPBZ), L6FBD (AUDPF) and the SPKxxx / PMxxx names, whose ESB sounds I did not identify.
$4C5C (written at L6C51 with the wave 1 level) and $4C5E (written at L6E14 with the wave 2 level) have no other use in any listing - not named.

which objects the two wave 2 handlers stand for (page 1: $4C64 / $4C6A, page 0: $4C65 / $4C6B, three records at $4A87) I did not settle from this range - presumably the two kinds of walkers. Likewise the wave 1 objects handled on page 2 are presumably the probots.
B0:68D5, 68F5, 691A-6926: the JSRL targets $B4A2 (planet), $B535, $B55F and $B58E are pictures in pseudo vector ROM set 0 (loaded by LA342 from table LB974) - not identified here.
L75AC caps the Jedi quota oddly: GM_DIF + 9 above $5A is replaced by $90, not $5A (L75C0).
